## E. Hinglish copy sweep (owner decision #12 — everything → English)

Confirmed real user-facing Hinglish exists (e.g. `app/partner/dashboard/page.tsx:1801`
"Pehla room type add karke pricing set karo."). A word-boundary scan
(hai/karo/kijiye/chahiye/aapka/milega/…) flags ~40 files; many hits are code
comments (allowed to stay per repo history, but user-facing strings must become
English). EXCEPTION (owner): the customer-support / complaint chat bot may OFFER
Hinglish chat as a language option — that feature stays.

Files flagged for triage (user-facing strings only):
`app/partner/dashboard/page.tsx` · `app/admin/services/page.tsx` ·
`app/admin/circle/page.tsx` · `app/auth/page.tsx` · `app/order/[outlet]/page.tsx` ·
`app/my-bids/page.tsx` · `app/hotels/[id]/page.tsx` + `feedback/` · `app/bid/page.tsx` ·
`app/circle/{[id],discover,build}/page.tsx` · `app/onboard/{wizard,signin,signup}/page.tsx` ·
`components/{DialerNav,ClimberMilestoneMap,Navbar,BidGameZone,StatusBarColor,ActiveBidConflictSheet}.tsx` ·
